method: Built-in imagegen produced the five complete scenes and aligned luminance mattes. Native SVG compositions apply those generated mattes without changing the source vehicle pixels, then export RGBA PNG foregrounds and lossless WebP. Matte values 0..2 map to fully transparent; 253..255 map to fully opaque. The website uses the final color cutouts, never the black-and-white mattes.

scenes.scenePrompt: Use case: compositing. Asset: a complete opaque photographic scene for the Ciudad Cars website, not a UI mockup. Image 1 is the EXACT background to keep. Preserve the exact wide 2.2:1 composition and every background landmark, sky, bridge, palm, railing, and road. Do not crop, zoom, darken, blur, tint or put a gradient over the image. Insert ONE metallic silver Mitsubishi Lancer sedan (stock 2008–2017 conventional road version, not Evo) on the empty foreground pavement. Put the entire car centered horizontally, front three-quarter view with its nose facing slightly toward image-left; its bounds approximately x=25%..77%, y=47%..90%. All tires, bumpers and mirrors completely visible with a clear margin below the tires. Natural scale: not an oversized car. Match the sunset lighting with warm highlights from the right, cool environmental reflections, and a subtle contact shadow immediately under the tires. Keep the car and local contact shadow crisp, never a heavy black oval. Keep all backdrop pixels outside the added car/shadow unchanged. This full scene will be followed by extraction of the exact vehicle as a separate aligned transparent layer, so composition consistency is crucial. Output one high-resolution landscape full-bleed image at the same aspect ratio, with no text, no labels, no frame, no UI, no additional cars or people.
scenes.maskPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, technical foreground isolation mask. Image 1 is the exact edit target. Output ONE grayscale segmentation MATTE at the identical full 1859×846 landscape canvas and framing. Every pixel of the vehicle silhouette (body, roof, windows, mirrors, wheels, tires, antenna, grille) must become pure WHITE (#FFFFFF). Every background pixel must become pure BLACK (#000000). Carefully trace the EXACT vehicle outline in the reference without moving it, scaling it, changing its proportions, cropping the canvas, or inventing edges. Fill the entire interior of the vehicle silhouette uniformly solid white, including dark windows and grille; leave black in the visible background gap underneath the chassis between tires. No car details or texture inside the silhouette. No checkerboard. No transparency needed: this is an opaque black-and-white MASK that will reveal the untouched original car pixels over the separate background. Add only a very narrow soft gray contact shadow right beneath each tire, no broad road region. The silhouette must align pixel-for-pixel with the original input image. Do not output a photo or a collage. Pure black background, pure white silhouette in its EXACT source position.
